pattern.description: The tight framing on the open Export menu cross-dissolves (double image visible at f1577) into a slightly wider, lower framing of the same UI, while the cursor continues down the menu and the hover highlight steps from PPTX to Send to Canva.
pattern.why_premium: A short dissolve between two framings of the same state hides a time jump in the screen recording while keeping the menu and cursor continuous, so the demo reads as one smooth take.

build_hint.gsap: Two stacked layers of the same UI at different framings: tl.fromTo('.frame-b', {opacity: 0, scale: 1.035, y: 20}, {opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.33, ease: 'power2.out'}).to('.frame-a', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.33, ease: 'power1.inOut'}, '<'); cursor tween y down the menu with ease 'power2.inOut'; hovered-row background swaps instantly (set) as the cursor crosses each row.
build_hint.remotion: Render two <Sequence> layers; opacity of layer B = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}), scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [1.035, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); layer A fades out over the same frames. Cursor y via interpolate with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic); row highlight switches on threshold frames.

notes: Could also be read as layout_reframe or a jump cut softened by a dissolve; code camera says tilt_down with scale 0.966, consistent with a reframe. The f1569 framing has a dark grey area on the left that is gone after the dissolve, so it may be two separate takes.
